# Sky News

> > Sky News delivers breaking news, in-depth analysis, and special coverage of major political events, including US elections and international affairs.

Sky News is a British news organization providing comprehensive coverage of global events. This collection focuses on their analysis of the 2018 US Midterm elections during Donald Trump's presidency, examining political polarization and partisan divisions in American politics.

## Key Topics

- Donald Trump
- US Midterms 2018
- Political polarization
- Republican-Democrat partisan divide
- Trump presidency
- American politics
- Gun control debate
- Immigration policy
- Abortion rights
- Mueller investigation
- Pew Research Center analysis
- United States political landscape

## US Political Coverage

- [US Midterms 2018 - Donald Trump | A Divided America](https://news.sky.com/donald-trump-midterms-2018): Trump's first term analysis covering Republican-Democrat divide on key issues
